title: Natively lazyload certain web components like tabs etc.
body:
Something we have done in our cms, was adding `lazyloading` to **tabs**, which increased performance for all themes and plugins.

It would be kind of nice if that was rolled out to tabs in a web standardized form.

An example from our cms:

Let's say a user is on a using a **2G/GPRS network** connection and the data is coming very slowly to their device:

- First - The `tab` list loads

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57409060/101786106-7472a100-3af5-11eb-8a5d-259f9e53ec38.png)

- Second - You see a blue loading spinner for the `tab content`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57409060/101786145-80f6f980-3af5-11eb-87a6-857815b29ce4.png)

- Third - The `tab content` gets loaded.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57409060/101786200-91a76f80-3af5-11eb-9015-29c075e90f1e.png)

Please note, when a user is using a **fast internet connection** all these sequences would take **milliseconds**.

Developers would just need to add an attribute to turn on Native lazy loading for the desired web component, with various options such as: `lazy` and `eager` see here: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#lazy-loading-attributes

Also related to this comment: https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/3752#issuecomment-504060118

Follows on from the discussion started here: https://github.com/WICG/open-ui/issues/238

CMS code pr for the lazyloading: https://github.com/octobercms/october/pull/4658

Discussion about removing the FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text) when a user loads a web page using a fragment url to one of the tabs directly: https://github.com/octobercms/october/issues/5393
